text:
Alex: Free — used upholstered sled chair (black) + steel desk frame (no top). Moving offices this weekend, need these gone. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Mira: Interested — is the chair height-adjustable? any rips/wear?
Alex: Chair has gas lift + tilt, no tears, one scuff on left arm. Frame is a steel 2-leg trestle that fits a 72x30 top. Height range 27\"–48\" with included legs.
Jarod: Does the frame include the crossbar and mounting bolts? any idea of weight/transport difficulty?
Alex: Crossbar included and bolts/nuts in a labeled zip bag. Assembled weight ~45lbs for the frame, chair ~20lbs. Bolt pattern info: `M8 x 8 hole pattern (approx 60mm spacing)`.
Kelly: I can pick up Sat afternoon. Which office/room should I check in at? :raised_hand:
Alex: Sorry, should have said — SoMa office. I'll leave everything disassembled in Conference C (right by reception). Check-in window 9am–5pm Sat.
Mira: Do you know if the frame has cable pass/grommet holes? need to know for my setup.
Alex: Yup — two pre-drilled holes near the center spine. See pic 3 in the album.
ops-bot: FYI — Office pickup policy: please sign in at reception and wear a visitor badge. Weekend access is still allowed, bring ID.
Jarod: If Kelly only wants the chair, I'm happy to take the frame. Happy to help carry it to a car if needed.
Kelly: If it's still available I'll take both. DMing Alex now. :sunglasses:
Alex: Kelly confirmed — DM'd to arrange pickup time. I'll mark the items with a Post-it that says "FREE — KELLY" so others don't move them.
Mira: Nice — thank you for giving them away instead of trashing. :recycle:
Kelly: Pickup scheduled for Sat 2pm. Will update here if anything changes.
Alex: Perfect, thanks everyone. If Kelly can't make it Jarod you're next in line. :thumbsup:
